item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":45,"statement":"DSPy only treats a `prediction` argument as a predicted-output payload when it is a `dict` whose `type` is exactly `\"content\"` and that also has a `content` key.","span_ids":["s1"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"When `prediction` matches that shape, DSPy removes it from the normal input kwargs, stores it in `config[\"prediction\"]`, and the forward path sends that config as `lm_kwargs`, so the LM/backend request receives `prediction` outside the ordinary signature inputs.","span_ids":["s1","s2","s3"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"If `prediction` does not match the predicted-output shape, DSPy does not move it into LM kwargs; when the signature declares a `prediction` input, it stays in the normal inputs instead, which is why the test with a string `prediction` shows no `prediction` kwarg on `litellm.completion`.","span_ids":["s1","s2","s4"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":171,"end_line":180},{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":243,"end_line":253},{"span_id":"s3","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":894,"end_line":907},{"span_id":"s4","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":909,"end_line":915}]}
